creditCustomers.title: Credit customers
creditCustomers.subtitle: Who may buy on credit, how much, and who approved it · one exposure per customer across the factory, shops, field sales and agents

2.title: Sales request
2.what: Asks for a limit and terms with expected business

7.title: Credit active
7.what: Orders can reserve credit up to the limit

creditCustomers.flowRule: A draft customer can buy for cash or advance. Credit starts only at step 7, and no one approves their own step or two steps of the same application. Rejections go back with a reason.
creditCustomers.emptyTitle: No customers for this company yet
creditCustomers.emptyBody: Add customers on Sales → Customers; their credit starts here with an application.
creditCustomers.pickHint: Choose a customer to see the exposure check, ask for a limit, or record an MD exception.

names.title: Names everything.
names.body: Customer, why, compensating checks, the maximum amount, the order it covers and the end time.

finance.title: Finance view kept.
finance.body: Finance's assessment is stored even when it is against.

ends.title: Ends by itself.
ends.body: Expiry or using up the amount stops further credit; a changed order is checked again.

noBypass.title: No bypass switch.
noBypass.body: Sales and finance managers can't override; there is no "skip all checks".

law.title: Law can't be waived.
law.body: Tax, invoicing and licensing rules apply whatever the exception says.

creditCustomers.submitted: Credit application {{no}} sent. It now waits for the sales manager (stage 3).
creditCustomers.noRequest: You do not have the right to ask for credit. Ask Admin.
creditCustomers.noMd: Only the MD records an exception.

app.title: Credit applications
app.emptyBody: Open a customer on the Customers tab and send an application.
app.pick: Choose an application to see its stages and decide the next one.
app.sodRule: a different person for every stage, never the one who asked
app.youAsked: You asked for this credit, so another person decides it.
app.youDecided: You decided an earlier stage, so another person decides this one.
app.noStageRight: This stage is decided by the {{who}}. You do not have that right.
app.active: Application {{no}} is approved: credit is active.
app.rejected: Application {{no}} is rejected and goes back with the reason.

ex.title: MD exceptions
ex.emptyBody: An exception is recorded by the MD on a customer or a held order.
